title: 명예교수규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00779:20010131:00005:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDUM (Enforcement Rules of the Organization of the Ministry of Education and Human Resources Development and Its Affiliated Agencies) <No. 779, January 31, 2001>
Article 1 (Enforcement Date) These Rules shall enter into force on the date of their promulgation.

Article 2 Omitted.

Article 3 (Amendment of Other Statutes or Regulations) (1) through (19) Omitted.

(20) Part of the Rules on Emeritus Professors shall be amended as follows:

In Article 6 (2), "Minister of Education" shall be replaced with "Minister of Education and Human Resources Development".

(21) through (41) Omitted.
